title: runtime: `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts?dryRun=true` ignores the unknown query parameter and performs a real publish
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A caller asking for a dry run gets a real, irreversible publish; the door has no closed query set.

## Reproduction

1. Create a package with one pending draft.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages/<id>/publish-drafts?dryRun=true` with `{}` → 200 `outcome:"published"`; the draft is live.

## Expected

An unknown query parameter is refused (closed query set, AGENTS rule), or `dryRun` is implemented as a real dry run.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` publish-drafts handler.

## Filing facts

- reach: HTTP, measured by the Interfaces QA card; coordinator re-verified.
- Business reason: Tools and AI agents that expect a preview publish for real.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:server`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `publish-drafts dryRun query parameter ignored performs real publish` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 15 hits, none about dryRun or the query set (nearest closed #10219, #25484).
- QA id: S3
